# bob logs

List and search phrase history from task logs

```text title="bob logs --help"
List and search phrase history from task logs

Bare `bob logs` runs the read-only phrase history list.

Usage: bob logs [COMMAND]

Commands:
  list  List reusable phrases from task logs (default)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help

Bare `bob logs` runs the read-only list.

Examples:
  \
bob logs                           List phrase history for every log
  \
bob logs -l work -q 'athena'      Find Work Log phrases
  \
bob logs -l schedule -f json      Print schedule history as JSON

See docs/log-recall.md for the log-history contract.
```

## bob logs list

List reusable phrases from task logs (default)

```text title="bob logs list --help"
List human-written summaries from the vault's Schedule, Work, Rotten, and Cancel Logs. The catalog is derived on each call and never writes to the vault. Matching uses exact, prefix, word-prefix, then substring tiers; the newest match is pinned before frecency ranking.

Bare `bob logs` runs this command. Human output shows 10 phrases per log by default; JSON shows 200.

Usage: bob logs list [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -b, --bob-dir <DIR>
          Bob vault root; defaults to BOB_DIR or ~/bob

  -f, --format <FORMAT>
          Output format: human or json

          [default: human]
          [possible values: human, json]

  -h, --help
          Show help

  -n, --limit <N>
          Show at most N phrases per log (human default 10; JSON default 200)

  -l, --log <KIND>
          Show one log kind; repeat to select several (default: all four)

          [possible values: schedule, work, rotten, cancel]

  -q, --query <TEXT>
          Filter and rank by an exact, prefix, word-prefix, or substring match

Examples:
  \
             bob logs
  \
             bob logs list -l work
  \
             bob logs -l work -q 'athena' -n 25
  \
             bob logs -l schedule -f json
  \
             bob logs -l work -l cancel -b ~/bob -f json

Environment:
  \
             BOB_DIR          Bob vault root when --bob-dir is omitted
  \
             NO_COLOR         Disable colored output

Exit codes:
  \
             0  list
  \
             1  vault I/O failure
  \
             2  usage or config error

See docs/log-recall.md for the log-history contract.
```
